dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Is there a pharmacy near here?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. ɪz ðɛr ə ˈfɑːrməsi ˈnɪr ˈhɪr?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, there is. It's between the temple and the market.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ðɛr ˈɪz. ɪts bɪˈtwiːn ðə ˈtɛmpəl ənd ðə ˈmɑːrkɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you! Is the post office near here, too?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː! ɪz ðə ˈpoʊst ˌɔːfɪs ˈnɪr ˈhɪr, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, it's far. It's next to the museum.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪts ˈfɑːr. ɪts ˈnɛkst tə ðə mjuˈziːəm.
